So those settings cannot be decided by English, and two pre-set flags that fired there (K4 −3.385 vs random −3.389; −3.743 at lags 51–55) are this artifact. **Short lags (12–22, 23 settings), solution-space search** (every state satisfies the anchor equations; quick run): planted English recovered 26/46, random letters ≤ −5.39, true English −4.3 to −4.6; K4 best −4.98 (lag 22 AZ −) to −5.46: below English, no flag. **Full run (2M × 12):** planted English recovered 37/46 (median accuracy 0.99; misses mostly at lags 14–15 KRYPTOS and lag 22); random-letter controls max −4.909 (median −5.539); lowest recovered truth −4.612. K4: best −4.921 (lag 22 AZ −1, same-setting random −4.942); every short-lag setting scores at random-letter level and far below English; at 12 of 23 settings the search found no fully valid alphabet with better text (penalty 1). FLAG: none → **STAT: short-lag autoclave (12–22) disfavored for conventional English plaintext** (weaker at lag 22, planted 0.66–0.74)
